articles.summary: It is commonly stated in the literature that T violation is zero in neutrino disappearance channels. We show this claim is not general: it holds only for symmetric matter profiles or when the T/CP-violating phase ($δ$) is 0 or $π$, that is, when the Jarlskog invariant is zero. articles.summary: This study examines one-day-ahead forecasting of the S&P 500 closing level using a 2006-2025 dataset that includes fundamental price data, macroeconomic indicators, and engineered technical features. articles.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
articles.summary: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. articles.title: A proof of the polygonal Faber--Krahn inequality
articles.summary: We prove that, for every integer $n\ge3$, the regular $n$-gon uniquely minimizes the first Dirichlet eigenvalue, up to congruence, among simple polygons of prescribed area with at most $n$ sides. articles.title: Task2Hand: A Contact-Grounded Skill for Parametric Dexterous-Hand Morphology Design
articles.summary: Dexterous hand design demands repeated expert work across geometry, robot-description code, collision debugging, grasp initialization, and policy training. We present Task2Hand, a Skill: a specification package that turns a functional manipulation brief into a parameterized hand model and routes every candidate through cost-ordered contact, dynamics, and learning gates. articles.title: Your Camera Can Hear You: Side-Channel Acoustic Eavesdropping via Android Camera2 Metadata
articles.summary: To prevent motion sensors from acting as covert microphones, Android 12+ caps SensorManager gyroscope and accelerometer rates at 200 Hz by default, requires HIGH_SAMPLING_RATE_SENSORS for higher rates, and throttles sensors back to 200 Hz when the microphone toggle is off. We show that Android's Camera2 subsystem bypasses these defenses. During an active Camera2 session, Camera HAL stabilization pipelines record high-rate gyroscope measurements and export them via vendor CaptureResult metadata.

articles.title: Non-penetrating World Models
articles.summary: We study a new problem of preventing object penetration in interactive video world models. To understand how existing models handle this, we introduce NoPeBench, a benchmark that evaluates how world models respond to physical obstacles. articles.summary: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. articles.summary: Red blood cells (RBCs) in Gaucher disease (GD) adhere abnormally to vessel walls and carry more Lutheran/basal cell adhesion molecule (Lu/BCAM), a laminin receptor. articles.title: Ranking-Preserving Coreset Selection for Efficient Evolutionary Hyperparameter Optimization
articles.summary: Hyperparameter optimization (HPO) is essential for high predictive performance, but its computational cost becomes prohibitive when candidate configurations require repeated training on large datasets. articles.summary: Small modular reactors (SMRs) are being considered as compact, high-energy-density power sources for future all-electric ships. articles.summary: Electrostatic screening is one of the most fundamental phenomena in electrolyte solutions. articles.summary: Buoyancy glitches in red giants provide localized information on the interior structure near the base of the convective envelope, but their properties are typically inferred from dedicated seismic modelling rather than global properties, limiting large-sample applications. articles.summary: Neuromorphic sensing and computing offer a promising alternative to conventional deep learning pipelines for mobile robots, where perception must run continuously under tight latency and energy constraints. articles.title: What Must a Model Tell a Planner? Outcome Interfaces for Risk-Aware Planning After Robot Damage
articles.summary: When a robot is damaged, it must decide which routes it can still afford, and the amount of risk it may accept can change from one mission to the next. articles.title: Star Triangulations

articles.summary: Autonomous racing requires an accurate vehicle dynamics model near the limits of handling, yet a mismatch between the nominal and actual dynamics inevitably remains. To reduce this mismatch, existing methods learn from on-track data, i.e., data collected while the vehicle drives on the track under racing conditions, by adapting the physical parameters of the nominal model or by learning a residual that captures the remaining mismatch. articles.summary: As part of the energy transition, underground hydrogen (H2) storage in porous media has emerged as an alternative solution for large-scale energy storage to salt caverns. articles.summary: Despite major advances in structure prediction, modelling the motions and interactions that drive biomolecular function at scale remains a central challenge. articles.summary: Public authorities increasingly need to translate multifaceted policy objectives into concrete fiscal and investment choices while accounting for their socioeconomic consequences. articles.summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) decompose diffusion model activations into interpretable features, but steering a model with them requires identifying which features map to a given semantic concept, if any. articles.summary: Cardiovascular imaging offers several ways to measure blood flow, but each provides an incomplete, resolution-limited, or noisy view of the underlying dynamics. articles.summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) exhibit strong semantic understanding but remain limited in their ability to reason about metric 3D space in the physical world. articles.summary: Sustaining user experience (UX) quality in large-scale web search requires scalable evaluation.
